$comment: The parts of each collector schema upstream doesn't describe, written by hand (D13c decisions 8 and 9) in the generated schema's own form: the service section, the definitions it refers to, and the components that take no settings (each closed: an empty map, null or a ${…} reference).

service.description: The service: the extensions the collector starts, its pipelines, and its own telemetry.
service.patternErrorMessage: Expected a map or a ${…} reference.

extensions.description: The extensions the collector starts, by id (type or type/name), in this order.
extensions.errorMessage: Expected a list or a string.

pipelines.description: The pipelines, by id: a signal (traces, metrics, logs or profiles), optionally followed by /name.
pipelines.patternErrorMessage: Expected a map or a ${…} reference.

telemetry.description: The collector's own telemetry: its logs, metrics and traces.
telemetry.$comment: Open: the collector's telemetry settings aren't checked (D13c decision 8).

pipeline.description: A pipeline: the receivers it reads from, the processors it runs, in order, and the exporters it writes to, each by id (type or type/name).
pipeline.patternErrorMessage: Expected a map or a ${…} reference.

exporters.description: The exporters (or connectors) this pipeline writes to, by id.
exporters.errorMessage: Expected a list or a string.

processors.description: The processors this pipeline runs, by id, in order.
processors.errorMessage: Expected a list or a string.

receivers.description: The receivers (or connectors) this pipeline reads from, by id.
receivers.errorMessage: Expected a list or a string.

withoutSettings.connector/forward: The forward connector passes data from one pipeline to another and takes no settings.
withoutSettings.connector/otlp_json: The OTLP JSON connector turns OTLP JSON found in log record bodies into logs, metrics or traces, and takes no settings.
withoutSettings.connector/round_robin: The round-robin connector spreads data across the pipelines it feeds, one after another, and takes no settings.
